title: Surgical handover documentation

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports recovery observation, pain or nausea assessment, discharge criteria, instructions, escort, complications, handover, and follow-up only as clinician-completed documentation.
user_facing_items.population: Patients receiving planned day surgery or procedure services in DoH-licensed facilities, with age, risk, procedure, anesthesia, and discharge qualifications.
user_facing_items.setting: DoH-licensed day surgery and procedure facilities in Abu Dhabi.
restrictions: UAE-direct for service governance, assessment, care plans, pre/intra/post-procedure documentation, records, discharge, and patient education. It does not replace anesthesiologist judgment, facility policy, consent, credentialing, or emergency care.

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports complete, contemporaneous records for assessment, consent, anesthesia or sedation, procedure, monitoring, recovery, discharge, complications, and follow-up.
user_facing_items.population: Patients receiving planned day surgery or procedure services in DoH-licensed facilities, with age, risk, procedure, anesthesia, and discharge qualifications.
user_facing_items.setting: DoH-licensed day surgery and procedure facilities in Abu Dhabi.
restrictions: UAE-direct for service governance, assessment, care plans, pre/intra/post-procedure documentation, records, discharge, and patient education. It does not replace anesthesiologist judgment, facility policy, consent, credentialing, or emergency care.
user_facing_items.rationale: Supports complete contemporaneous assessment, procedure, recovery and follow-up records for surgical handover documentation; no decision is generated.

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports complete and accurate medicine information, prescribed and non-prescribed medicines, allergies, timing, monitoring, and discussion at care transitions.
user_facing_items.population: Adults, children, and young people using medicines, with specific transfer, reconciliation, and decision-involvement recommendations.
user_facing_items.setting: Transfers between care settings and clinician-led medicines consultations.
user_facing_items.jurisdiction: England and Wales; international evidence requiring UAE medicines, prescribing, pharmacy, discharge, and information-governance adaptation
restrictions: Exact for documenting current medicines, changes made during transfer, reconciliation, discrepancies, person or carer involvement, values, preferences, and clinician-led decisions. It does not generate a medicine start, stop, dose, prescription, or deprescribing decision.
user_facing_items.rationale: Supports complete medicine, allergy, monitoring and transfer information for surgical handover documentation; no decision is generated.
